DESCRIPTION_KR: Anna Sui’s Fall/Winter 2025 collection is inspired by the extravagant and uninhibited lifestyles of "madcap heiresses" like Barbara Hutton and Peggy Guggenheim. Influenced by their opulence and films such as Bringing Up Baby, the collection embraces bold self-expression, escapism, and a touch of whimsical fantasy. This season’s designs feature three captivating color stories—teals and greens, magentas and russet browns, and purples and black—brought to life with rich textures like tweeds, velvets, faux furs, and lacy rayons. The collection celebrates a dreamy, imaginative world of audacious luxury and individuality. With this round frame and gradient lenses, AS1183 the sunglasses offer a perfect balance of vintage elegance and modern sophistication. AS1184 the sunglasses showcase a bold round frame with a subtle geometric twist. Both styles include the signature butterfly and iconic heart details, delivering a playful, whimsical charm to these standout accessories.; ABOUT ANNA SUI; ANNA SUI premiered her first runway show in 1991, and since then has grown from ready-to-wear to include accessories, cosmetics, and fragrances. As an independent, female-run brand, she has cemented herself as one of the most beloved and accomplished fashion designers. Born in Detroit, the career of Anna Sui is a classic American success story. Sui has received numerous awards, including the CFDA Perry Ellis Award for New Fashion Talent (1992) & the CFDA Geoffrey Beene Lifetime Achievement Award (2009). She has published two books, ANNA SUI by Andrew Bolton (2010) and THE WORLD OF ANNA SUI by Tim Blanks (2017) and opened “The World of Anna Sui” museum exhibition in London which has traveled to Tokyo, New York, Shanghai, Ft. Lauderdale, Charlotte and More. A passionate advocate for New York’s Garment District, Sui has located her business and produced fashion lines in New York City for the past forty years.

DESCRIPTION_KR: Sleek and stylish, the AllSaints Spring/Summer 25 optical eyewear collection is a symphony of contemporary design. The unisex collection, made entirely from sustainable Acetate Renew*, reaffirms the British brand’s 30 years as a global fashion leader. Balancing industrial touches with wearable modernism, the on-trend and contemporary eyewear designs remain stylish throughout every season, complementing the hugely popular AllSaints apparel. Focusing on thick-rimmed and directional shapes adorned with distinctive metal hardware accents, the new AllSaints optical collections offer dynamic and wearable options for style lovers. Experimenting with proportion and fashion-forward silhouettes, the AllSaints opticals provide a restrained colour palette to match the understated and stylish attitude of its wearers.; Mondottica designs world-class fashion eyewear for some of the biggest brands in fashion. Working with the smallest boutique opticians to the biggest chain retailers, we distribute designer eyewear to over 80 countries, meaning Mondottica is a true world citizen. From humble beginnings, the eyewear company now has offices and operations in Hong Kong, London, Oyonnax, Molinges, Tokyo, Barcelona, Delhi, Moscow, New York and Sydney with distribution reach that spans all continents. Holding the licenses for a wide range of lifestyle and fashion brands, namely Anna Sui, All Saints, Cath Kidston, Karen Millen, Maje, Pepe Jeans, Sandro, Ted Baker (worldwide except USA and Canada), United Colors of Benetton and Vivienne Westwood, ensures Mondottica is ideally placed to cater to a broad demographic of style conscious consumers.

Influenced by their opulence and films such as Bringing Up Baby, the collection embraces bold self-expression, escapism, and a touch of whimsical fantasy. This season’s designs feature three captivating color stories—teals and greens, magentas and russet browns, and purples and black—brought to life with rich textures like tweeds, velvets, faux furs, and lacy rayons. The collection celebrates a dreamy, imaginative world of audacious luxury and individuality. With this round frame and gradient lenses, AS1183 the sunglasses offer a perfect balance of vintage elegance and modern sophistication. AS1184 the sunglasses showcase a bold round frame with a subtle geometric twist. Both styles include the signature butterfly and iconic heart details, delivering a playful, whimsical charm to these standout accessories.; ABOUT ANNA SUI; ANNA SUI premiered her first runway show in 1991, and since then has grown from ready-to-wear to include accessories, cosmetics, and fragrances. As an independent, female-run brand, she has cemented herself as one of the most beloved and accomplished fashion designers. Born in Detroit, the career of Anna Sui is a classic American success story. Sui has received numerous awards, including the CFDA Perry Ellis Award for New Fashion Talent (1992) & the CFDA Geoffrey Beene Lifetime Achievement Award (2009). She has published two books, ANNA SUI by Andrew Bolton (2010) and THE WORLD OF ANNA SUI by Tim Blanks (2017) and opened “The World of Anna Sui” museum exhibition in London which has traveled to Tokyo, New York, Shanghai, Ft. Lauderdale, Charlotte and More. A passionate advocate for New York’s Garment District, Sui has located her business and produced fashion lines in New York City for the past forty years.

NAME_KR: The Next Interface: A Design-Led Vision for Smart Eyewear
NAME_EN: The Next Interface: A Design-Led Vision for Smart Eyewear
DESCRIPTION_KR: The Design Philosophy: Wearable, Not Noticeable; The answer is a frame that draws inspiration from the confident lines of futuristic architecture and the dynamic flow of urban light bands. The silhouette is bold yet ergonomic, engineered for all-day comfort. The primary color palette of aerospace black and smoked grey establishes a sophisticated, versatile base, while strategic accents of warm orange or electric blue on interactive zones provide a subtle hint of its technological capabilities. This is smart eyewear designed not as a gadget, but as a essential, stylish accessory for the modern professional.; Engineering Elegance: A Modular Platform for the Future; A key innovation of this platform is its modular architecture. We recognize that brand partners have diverse technological goals. Therefore, the design incorporates intelligent features that are both conceptual and production-ready:; 1. Modular Temple System: The temples feature internal slots designed to house various plug-and-play modules—such as audio, environmental sensors, or connectivity packs. This allows brands to customize functionality without redesigning the entire frame, offering unparalleled flexibility.; 2. Discreet Interaction: Touch-sensitive panels are seamlessly integrated into the temple sides, providing intuitive swipe and tap controls while preserving the design's clean lines.; 3. Future-Proof Optics: The lens system is quick-change compatible and includes a reserved margin for integrating light-guide elements, paving the way for future augmented reality displays without a bulky form factor.; We provide end-to-end creative collaboration, from industrial design and prototyping to brand storytelling. Let's collaborate to define the next chapter of intelligent eyewear.; Explore the technical documentation and initiate a partnership discussion at www.jeffreyleungeyeweardesign.com

NAME_KR: 🎨 JEFFREY LEUNG EYEWEAR DESIGN Launches Premium Color Dyeing Service for 3D Printed Eyewear Components
NAME_EN: 🎨 JEFFREY LEUNG EYEWEAR DESIGN Launches Premium Color Dyeing Service for 3D Printed Eyewear Components
DESCRIPTION_KR: At JEFFREY LEUNG EYEWEAR DESIGN, we believe that color tells a story—one that communicates a brand’s essence, emotion, and innovation. That’s why we’re excited to introduce our new professional color dyeing service, tailored specifically for 3D printed eyewear parts and frames.; As 3D printing reshapes the landscape of eyewear design, designers gain more creative freedom than ever before. Yet one common challenge remains: how to infuse vibrant, accurate, and consistent color into these advanced materials. Our latest service addresses this gap—bringing precise, high-quality dyeing to nylon-based 3D printed parts, while elevating every frame with striking, durable color.; We offer a growing library of curated seasonal palettes and custom color matches, tailored for brands that value individuality and design integrity. Whether you're launching a bold fashion-forward collection or crafting timeless pieces, our service supports Pantone matching and bespoke development to align with your exact brand vision.; Designed with both emerging and established brands in mind, our service provides:; - Rich, even color coverage across complex geometries - High repeatability for production-scale consistency - Custom color creation guided by our in-house dye specialists - Finishing options: matte, satin, or semi-gloss coating; Whether you're creating limited edition prototypes or preparing for global production, our process is designed to scale with your needs. We work closely with international eyewear brands, independent labels, and fashion-forward designers to ensure the final product is both visually impactful and technically reliable.; The result? Colorful, expressive, and durable eyewear pieces that enhance your design narrative.; From bold statements to understated tones, we help brands use color as a form of identity and distinction—a critical advantage in today’s competitive market.; Ready to explore the future of eyewear with us?; ---; Get in Touch; We’re currently accepting bookings for dyeing consultations, sampling, and production for Q3 and Q4 2025. Whether you're looking to explore a new palette or scale up your next collection, we’re here to support you with expertise, innovation, and style.; 📩 Contact us to request a sample or color consultation.

NAME_KR: Conventional Progressive Lens, Stock Multifocal Lens
NAME_EN: Conventional Progressive Lens, Stock Multifocal Lens
DESCRIPTION_KR: What Are Progressive Lenses?; Progressive lenses are true “multifocal” lenses that provide an infinite number of lens strengths in one pair of glasses. Optimum-vision runs the length of the lens to allow for each distance to be clear:; Top of lens: ideal for distance vision, driving, and walking.; Middle of lens: ideal for computer vision, intermediate distances.; Bottom of the lens: ideal for reading or completing other close-up activities.; As we age, it becomes more difficult to look at objects that are close to our eyes. This is a very common condition called presbyopia. Most people first notice when they have trouble reading fine print, or when they have headaches after reading, due to eyestrain.; Progressives are intended for people who need correction for presbyopia, but do not want a hard line in the middle of their lenses.; With progressive lenses, you won't need to have more than one pair of glasses with you. You don't need to swap between your reading and regular glasses.; Vision with progressives can seem natural. If you switch from viewing something up close to something far away, you won't get a "jump" like you would with bifocals or trifocals.; It takes 1-2 weeks to adjust to progressives. You need to train yourself to look out of the lower part of the lens when you're reading, to look straight ahead for distance, and to look somewhere between the two spots for middle distance or computer work.; During the learning period, you may feel dizzy and nauseas from looking through the wrong section of lens. There may also be some distortion of your peripheral vision.; You Need A Pair o f Anti-blue Progressive Lenses; As blue lights nowadays is everywhere, anti-blue Progressive Lenses are ideal for indoor activities, such as watching TV, playing on the computer, reading books and reading newspapers, and suitable for outdoor walks, driving, traveling and daily wear throughout the year.

DESCRIPTION_KR: What Semi Finished Lens Blanks Can do?; Spectacle lenses production units that transform semi-finished lenses into finished lenses according the precise characteristics of a prescription.; The customization work of laboratories enables us to provide a wide variation of optical combinations for wearer needs,; especially as regards the correction of presbyopia. In the case of a freeform progressive lens, the back surface geometry includes the progressive design. The freeform process utilises semi-finished spherical lenses which are readily available in a wide range of base curves and indices. These lenses are accurately machined on the back side using state-of-the-art generating and polishing equipment to create the exact prescription surface.; • the front surface is a simple spherical surface; • the back surface is a complex three-dimensional surface; Technology for freeform lenses; • Provides the flexibility to offer a wider range of high level products, even for the smaller optical laboratory; • Only requires a stock of semi-finished spheres in each material from any quality source; • Lab management is simplified with significantly fewer SKUs; • Progressive surface is closer to the eye - providing broader fields of view in the corridor and reading area; • Accurately reproduces the intended progressive design; • Prescription accuracy is not limited by the tooling steps available in the laboratory; • Accurate prescription alignment is guaranteed

Our wide range of eyewear productions, quick response & delivery, a high standard of industrial technology and excellent customer services help us succeed nowadays. We can meet your specific needs, and we are very pleased to work with you in the future.
